answer: Work waits on the cedar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the quill of the next round. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The ocean of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
